column1: This is an example of our year wise database for precipitation
Each year we organize Monsoon Expedetion from May to September, which is the period in which we receive nearly 80% of annual rainfall.
The preparation of this database is semi-automated (manual entry for meausrement comments)
The daily rainfall data (24 hr) in mm collecetd by each citizen scientust is entered for each day from May 1 to the end of September (In the year , the monsoon lasted till early October)
The CS_Information sheet contains the details of all the citizen scientists along with their location details
